title: Your Pixel 11 won’t miss a chance to tell when it’s using the new Extreme Charging Mode
summary: The Pixel Weather screensaver will be one of those places where it shows.
body: Credit: Rita El Khoury / Android Authority TL;DR Pixel Weather is getting subtle upgrades, including a new icon, right after the Pixel 11 launch. The AI weather summary is now called Weather Brief, while the app tells you the last time it updated the weather. Pixel Weather Screensaver is also getting ready to inform you when your device uses the new Extreme Charging Mode. Just after officially launching the new Pixel devices yesterday , Google is pushing out a set of new icons to its system apps. One of those is the Pixel Weather app, which is not only getting a slightly updated icon, but also a few new features that we’ve discovered and will discuss below.
